bullets: Added command-scoped attribution for sponsored procedures, appending an opaque click ID to procedure inputs when an advertiser link is present.
Fixed the BYOK request transform to drop unsupported fields and rename parameters for Luna and OpenRouter OpenAI endpoints.
Added Singapore and Israel to free-mode grandfathering for subscribers who bought full-access plans before their countries dropped to limited access.
Updated the post-signup questionnaire by retiring several referral, role, and subscription options and adding a tally version to rebuild answer counts.
Added web and CLI login surface values to the onboarding questionnaire to distinguish dashboard submissions from command-line and desktop entries.
Added storage intent angle and a foundation-backend-desktop mode to sponsored backend recommendations.
Updated the Supabase setup invitation to require recognized third-party provider packages as proof before offering an invitation.
Added a v3 Supabase setup invitation capability and v2 card, allowing Mac and Linux users to see the offer with lighter project checking.
Improved advertiser redaction to version 3, adding semantic codes that display as a generic context-filtered explanation.
Added forecast and coverage fields to the subscription cost report, mostly recording the system waiting on more precise numbers.
Added a subscription cost snapshot that preserves the last known cost report even if a background refresh is interrupted.
